newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's per capita income rose to $1,323 in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's per capita income rose to $1,323 in 1996.

text.p: Morocco's gross per capita income in current prices rose to 12,304 dirhams ($1,323) in 1996 from 10,963 dirhamsin 1995, the Statistics Directorate said.

In its monthly newsletter received on Tuesday, the state-run directorate said: "Morocco's gross national disposable revenue in current prices rose 12 percent to 12,304 dirhams in 1996 compared with the previous year."
It said the figures were provisional.
Morocco's overall GDP in current prices rose to 320.9 billion dirhams in 1996 compared with 281.2 billion in 1995.

"Agriculture was the main contributor to GDP surge in 1996. The sector generated 79 percent added value and participated at a level of 20.4 percent in the formation of the country's GDP against 14.8 percent in 1995," it said.
Morocco harvested a record 10 million tonnes of cereals in 1996 against 1.6 million tonnes in 1995 due to a severe drought.
Morocco's GDP was 279.3 billion dirhams in 1994, the directorate added.
The finance ministry earlier said Morocco's economy was expected to register zero growth in 1997, down from 12 percent in 1996 due mainly to a serious drop in agriculture output.
